summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Personal Job Search and Application Assistant, detailing the responsive React frontend dashboard, the compliant multi-portal job discovery system for Tamil Nadu roles (React/Frontend/Full Stack), the rule-based job matching engine, the application automation & assisted submission workflow, the Root-Cause Analysis and Recovery Center, the outreach template generator, the live preview REST API and standalone Spring Boot 3 + MongoDB Atlas backend, and the verified ₹0 free-tier deployment guide.
